Q0417

“The function of philosophy is not to increase positive knowledge, but to…” — Feng Youlan (Q0417)

An English quotation associated with A Short History of Chinese Philosophy, organized here under philosophy.

Quotes / Feng Youlan / Q0417

English

The function of philosophy is not to increase positive knowledge, but to raise the level of the spirit.
Thinker Feng Youlan
School Modern New Confucianism
Source A Short History of Chinese Philosophy
Theme Philosophy

Context and commentary are editorial aids for reading. They do not replace the primary text or scholarly commentary.

Source context

Archive record: this English passage is associated with A Short History of Chinese Philosophy, within the Modern New Confucianism tradition. Use the cited work or edition when a scholarly attribution is needed.

A short reading

Read in the register of philosophy, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Feng Youlan's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
